summary: Added meterbill/money.py (round_amount, allocate, legacy_cents, fixed) and routed every rounding and fixed-place format through it; removed the decimal context line from __init__.py. Batch worker threads used the default half-even context for band charges and price per kWh while bill/quote/tariffs used half-up, so that is kept via a keyword-only `rounding` parameter (an inconsistency left as is). Tests pass, new tests/test_money.py added, and output matched the original on 600+ generated commands.
